title: Rename the top-level child() test helper in progress_widgets_test.dart
why: A top-level function literally named `child` is called as `SingleChildScrollView(child: child(level))` (line 483) in the same file — the free function shares its name with the ubiquitous Flutter `child:` named parameter used dozens of times elsewhere in the same 583-line file, forcing a reader to disambiguate 'parameter or function?' at every occurrence.
acceptance_criteria: No top-level test helper shares a name with a common Flutter named parameter (child, key, builder, etc.)

corrections: Minor overstatement: `child:` appears only 8 times in the file (grep -c confirmed), not 'dozens' as claimed. Does not change the verdict.
